myobPush.needLock: Submit and lock this pay period before pushing
myobPush.unmapped: This store is not mapped to a MYOB company yet. Set it on the MYOB page (Store mappings)
myobPush.error: Could not load the MYOB push preview. Refresh the page and try again

birthdayTodo.text: {{name}} turned {{age}} on {{date}} but the age-based pay rate has not been updated: change the base hourly rate in MYOB first, then use “Sync from MYOB” on the pay rates tab with effective date {{date}}.

alerts.multiStoreTitle: {{count}} staff also clocked in at another store:
alerts.multiStoreTail: . These hours are not in this sheet.
alerts.merged: Hours from other stores are merged into this sheet (view only; data unchanged).
alerts.holidayBody: {{name}} ({{type}}) was rostered on {{count}} {{weekday}}s in the last {{weeks}} weeks (rule: ≥{{min}}); may be owed {{hours}} h paid public holiday.
alerts.birthdayMinorBody: Age-based pay rates may need updating; check the pay rates tab.

hours.tiersSub: Weekends and public holidays use actual hours at their own rate
hours.pendingSub: Incl. {{count}} public holiday confirmation(s); clear all before submitting

legend.note: Cell = paid hours that day (h); leave cells show requested paid hours — finance confirms the final figure

pay.formulaPayable: Actual paid hours (weekday / Sat / Sun / PH) + paid leave (annual leave as confirmed by finance)
pay.formulaTransfer: Fixed hours/week × weeks, filled Sun → Sat → leave → PH → weekday, each at its transfer rate
pay.formulaCash: Remaining hours × cash rate (one rate for all days) ± allowance
pay.pendingSub: {{count}} items still pending; totals may change
pay.readySub: Nothing pending; ready to submit and lock
pay.rateMissing: A tier with hours has no rate, so it is not paid; update the pay rates first
pay.footnote: Paid leave uses the weekday transfer rate; cash-only staff are paid all hours (incl. leave) at the cash rate. Hours are rounded to 2 decimals before multiplying; amounts to the cent.

warnings.MISSING_TRANSFER_RATE: A tier with hours has no transfer rate; that part is not paid
warnings.MISSING_CASH_RATE: No cash rate; the cash part is not paid
warnings.BELOW_MINIMUM_RATE: A rate is below your minimum rate

rates.birthdayHint: {{name}} turned {{age}} on {{date}} but the rate was set at age {{previous}}; check it and add a new effective record.
rates.footnote: Set the minimum rate yourself from each employee's award level and age; any tier below it is shown in red. Under-21s are flagged after their birthday.
rates.leaveRateHint: Paid leave uses the weekday transfer rate; cash-only staff use the cash rate for all hours
rates.belowMinimumHint: Rates in red are below your minimum rate
rates.trialTitle: Trial for this period ({{from}} – {{to}}), {{hours}} h payable:
rates.readOnly: Read only: editing rates needs the Payroll edit permission

validation.transferRequired: Fill in all four transfer rates
validation.fixedRequired: Transfer + cash needs fixed transfer hours

rates.publicHolidayHint: The public holiday rate may differ from the weekday rate (MYOB public holiday multiplier); leave it blank to use the weekday rate.

sync.title: Sync transfer rates from MYOB
sync.intro: Reads MYOB only and writes its base hourly rate into the transfer rates here (adds an effective-dated record; history is kept and nothing is written back to MYOB). The weekday rate is synced; Saturday / Sunday / public holiday are suggestions derived from the MYOB pay category multipliers, so review them before ticking.
sync.noCompany: This store has no paying company yet. Set one up on the MYOB page first.
sync.noRows: No staff in this store are linked to this company
sync.notBound: {{n}} more staff aren't linked to this company and are not listed
sync.confirmTitle: Add rate records for {{employees}} staff ({{cells}} items)?
sync.confirmOverwrite: {{n}} items overwrite current rates (old records stay in the history).
sync.confirmNote: Only adds records; history is unchanged and nothing is written back to MYOB.

reason.MYOB_RATE_NOT_HOURLY: MYOB card isn't hourly, or has no base rate
reason.MYOB_CARD_MISSING: Employee card not found in MYOB
reason.PAY_MODE_CASH: Cash-only here; no transfer rate needed
reason.CATEGORY_NOT_MAPPED: Category not mapped on the mapping page
reason.CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND: Mapped category no longer exists in MYOB
reason.CATEGORY_NOT_ON_CARD: Category isn't on this MYOB card

failure.MYOB_RATE_SYNC_NOT_IN_PREVIEW: Not in this preview. Reload and try again.
failure.MYOB_RATE_SYNC_VALUE_CHANGED: Rates changed in MYOB or here after the preview. Reload and try again.
failure.MYOB_RATE_SYNC_NOT_APPLICABLE: Nothing left to write for these cells

submit.pendingTip: Clear all pending items for this period first
submit.confirmContent: After submitting {{period}}, rosters, punches, punch fixes, approvals, leave, rates and notes for this store and period can no longer be changed until it is unlocked (separate permission, logged).

unlock.title: Unlock {{period}}
unlock.hint: The period becomes editable again; the action is logged.
